Author: Macki
Name: Glance
Description: Camera-facing gaze, configurable close-up framing, themed personality moods and a searchable catalog of unlocked in-game emotes. Customize facial expressions or opt into body animations. Configure with /glance. Icon created with AI assistance.
Punchline: A little eye contact. A little personality.
Changelog: GPose handoff preserves gaze and expression without queued resets, resumes after exit, and uses validated world-position gaze tracking. Existing close-up camera behavior is retained.
